name: Volume of Interest (VOI) Extraction with Sampling
definition: A technique to extract a rectangular sub-region from a 3D volume dataset and optionally downsample it using integer sampling rates, implemented via the VTK filter vtkExtractVOI.
summary: Volume of Interest Extraction with Sampling extracts a rectangular sub-region from a 3D volume using integer strides for downsampling, offering computational simplicity over interpolation-based methods.
